bin_definitions.horizon: Calendar months since shared TIME_FIT_END: October 2024 = 1, March 2025 = 6.
bin_definitions.mrt_distance: Nearest open MRT km: [0,0.5), [0.5,1), [1,2), [2,infinity); negative distance is invalid, missing/nonfinite is <missing>.
bin_definitions.categories: Missing or blank town/flat type is <missing>; no rows are excluded.
bin_definitions.rare_segment: Town x flat type has fewer than 30 rows in this holdout; descriptive flag, not a cause.
bin_definitions.calibration: Up to 10 empirical quantile bins of held-out predictions; duplicate edges are dropped; constant predictions use one bin. Bins are descriptive, with no fitted recalibration.

case_review_limit: Categories are observed flags, not verified causes. Unrecorded unit floor, condition, facing, renovation and tenancy context are plausible omitted information; their effects cannot be assigned to these records.

outliers.large_error_definition: Absolute residual strictly greater than SGD 1000
outliers.caveat: True-rent subsets and trimming are retrospective sensitivities. All holdout rows remain in the reported score; large residuals do not confirm recording errors.
